Formulas (Part 1–2): Total Sales = Quantity × Unit Price × (1 − Discount); Profit = (Unit Price − Cost Price) × Quantity. Totals reconcile 100% with the source dataset (5,000 of 5,000 transactions). Gender is stored as codes M/F in the source data.
